items.title: ElevenLabs upgrades ElevenMusic: adds 'References' style-matching and 'Vocals' voice generation
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs updated its AI music generator ElevenMusic with two features: 'References,' which lets users set a track's style and mood from 10s-5min of reference audio, and 'Vocals,' which generates original songs using the user's own voice or a voice library. Styles now officially supports the Music v2 model, and uploads must pass copyright checks before use.

items.title: Fender Studio Pro 8.1 review: AI stem separation, generation and a Studio Assistant land in Fender's DAW
items.excerpt: MusicTech reviews Fender's free Studio Pro 8.1 DAW, which now leans heavily on AI: a Moises-powered engine handles both stem separation and stem generation, alongside voice replacement and AI vocal pitch-correction. A new beta 'Studio Assistant' chatbot (Pro+ tier) answers production questions inside the app. A mainstream, no-cost DAW folding Moises-grade AI directly into the mixing workflow.

items.title: iZotope VEA - one-knob AI vocal enhancement built from RX and Nectar tech - is free until July 31
items.excerpt: iZotope is giving away VEA (normally $29), a stripped-down vocal-enhancement plugin that repackages the AI-assisted processing from its RX, Ozone and Nectar suites into three controls - Clean, Shape and Boost - for de-noising, tone-shaping and presence. Aimed at podcasters, streamers and producers who want RX-grade cleanup without the deep interface, it lowers the barrier to iZotope's machine-learning audio tools. Free window runs through July 31, 2026.

items.title: Ocean Swift Intros DevOcean Modular Synthesis & Sound Design Environment
items.excerpt: Ocean Swift released DevOcean Modular, a 145-module software modular synthesis and sound-design environment. Its standout feature is MaYa, a built-in modular AI agent that patches alongside the user, suggesting and wiring modules during the creative process - an early example of a generative AI 'co-patcher' embedded inside a modular synth workflow rather than a text-to-song generator.

items.title: BandLab Technologies buys Aiode, an AI music studio built on 'fully-licensed' audio
items.excerpt: BandLab Technologies acquired Aiode, an AI-powered music studio that lets creators build tracks using audio-to-audio models developed with professional session musicians. Its distinguishing pitch is that 100% of the training audio is licensed and traceable. Creators can generate performances section by section, spin up alternate takes and export projects as stems or full mixes - positioning it as a 'responsible' route for making music with AI.

items.title: Lorde slams Spotify's 'About the Song' feature over inaccurate AI-generated descriptions
items.excerpt: Lorde publicly criticized Spotify's beta 'About the Song' feature, which uses AI to generate song descriptions from third-party sources, after it published inaccurate details about her track 'Current Affairs.' She argued that reducing a song to an AI-generated meaning 'right at the source' limits free interpretation, and called for an artist opt-out. Spotify removed the offending text - a flashpoint over AI mediating how listeners understand music.
